script: Global carbon emissions reached forty-two point three billion tonnes in the past year — a record high. Sea levels have risen by three point three millimetres annually since 1993. Scientists project a further one to two metre rise by 2100 under current trajectories. One hundred and ninety-five countries signed the Paris Agreement, committing to limit warming to one point five degrees Celsius. Yet renewable energy still accounts for only twenty-nine percent of global electricity generation. The economic cost of climate-related disasters exceeded two hundred and seventy billion dollars last year alone. Every year we delay action increases the price of adaptation by three hundred billion dollars.
